premises.text: Mobile teams need more than email to share files, talk, and calendar together while working from phones
premises.evidence_span: email doesn't really cut it for us all the time. And our phones, I mean, somehow this became my office. And yet I feel very dysfunctional, because there's so many times when I need to work with a group of people, and I just can't

premises.text: Zula is a structured messaging stream with integrated file sharing, polls, cloud-drive file views, calendar events, and search across long-lived conversations
premises.evidence_span: we started off with a very standard messaging stream, a structured messaging stream. And we said, OK, what do we need to add to this for business tools to really get things done together as a team?

premises.text: People are invited from contacts and social graphs via deep links that land them directly in the conversation
premises.evidence_span: They get a deep link, which takes them directly to this conversation

premises.text: One-tap in-stream conference calling starts a synchronous call with push notifications and no phone numbers
premises.evidence_span: we have one tap conference calling

value.text: Help teams get things done together while reducing reliance on email
value.evidence_span: this is the beginning of reducing email and moving into a much more structured way of communicating as a team

causal_links.evidence_span: email doesn't really cut it for us all the time
get things done together as a team
I need to actually have a synchronous conversation
